svg.title: How a new Champion is rolled out safely
svg.desc: Drift is recorded when conditions change. A candidate is first tested in the shadow, then rolled out in stages of 5, 25, and 50 percent while the old Champion keeps its title. Healthy evidence at 50 percent promotes the candidate. A regression at any stage aborts automatically. After completion, a live check can roll back automatically.

text.font-family: ui-sans-serif, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Rolling out a new Champion, one stage at a time

svg.text: The old Champion keeps the title until the very last stage passes.
